notes.title: Patch 6 - The Big One!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/faad5de2e1659baff56e6db8c97980d77b5e2c2b.png[/img]

Fellow Survivors,

We’re excited to reveal our latest content update for Serum, this adds more of the road map content we revealed during the early access launch. Patch 6 is quite possibly our biggest update so far, and brings a lot of new player focused enhancements, and brought about some fixes that should iron out those performance issues some players were encountering. Tackling optimisation fixes was a much larger task than we first anticipated since it meant really getting under the hood of he game.

In addition to the new content, and performance tweaks, we’ve also been able to implement lots of other fixes to the game as well, and these addressed areas such as item storage, Inventory, missing localized text, UI and visual elements which should also make a big difference.

In patch 6 we’ve added Steam achievements and there are 23 to obtain in Serum. These achievements include various tasks such as finding the Pilot, defeating the formidable Alpha Wolf, recycling 100 items to gain valuable components, collecting all available files in the archive, and utilizing the Absorber 30 times among many others to obtain.

Based on player feedback you’ll be pleased to know that the Player difficulty level can now be customised giving you the option to adjust the level of challenge you’d prefer.
Included in this latest content patch are Combat traps providing you with even more tactical options against the creatures that roam Serums dangerous world.

Lastly, we’ve also added additional language support in addition to the 9 languages the game currently supports,

Let us know what you think of the update in our [url=https://discord.gg/fvuWbPMb66]Discord channel[/url].

Also, be sure to check out our latest Serum game stream on Serum’s official steam page where we go over all the recent updates including the new freestanding absorbers, trap placement function, achievements and the new combat traps.

[u][b]EA v0.1.6 | build 12059[/b][/u]

[b]Added Content[/b]
•	23 Steam Achievements
•	Additional language support
•	Difficulty Level Customization
•	Combat Traps (Slashing, piercing and blunt force variants)

[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]
•	Changing weapons and scanner using mouse wheel
•	Quick keys to use items in inventory
•	Filters in inventory

[b]Fixes[/b]
•	Fixed rare issue where incorrect effects were granted for the player upon Serum injection
•	Fixed issue where player was unable to put more than seven Serums into the Storage
•	Fixed issue where recycling items from storage resulted in items being dismantled twice
•	Fixed bug where player could use one Serum multiple times if it was used from Inventory screen
•	Fixed issue with destructible walls and vines reappearing after loading the game
•	Fixed rare issue with tracked quest disappearing from HUD after loading the game
•	Fixed issue where if items were first disassembled from the inventory and then from the storage, the items from the storage were not being removed
•	Fixed issue where after opening storage number of bandages on HUD was not being updated anymore
•	Fix for the serum tab not working properly while adding serum to weapon when activated by the button located in the centre of the screen
•	Tweaked Fumetoad's loot so it can be put into storage (one thing was set incorrectly)
•	Fixed issue where sometimes the axe image would appear before the correct icon loaded in the crafting screen
•	Fixed issue where sometimes the axe image would appear before the correct icon loaded in the crafting screen
‌
[b]Performance tweaks:[/b]
•	Mosquitoes are not casting shadows anymore,
•	Removed grass bending components from player and rabbits which were not working anyway
•	Tweaked static meshes mobility settings, so they are not set to movable if they do not move at all
•	River shader changed to increase performance
•	Data layers reorganized to increase performance
•	Decreased world partition loading range to 10,000 and cell size to 3800
•	Performance issues while opening bestiary in notebook
‌
[b]Other Improvements / Adjustments[/b]
•	Inventory screen implemented
•	Nakata boss can attack the player from further away
•	Loot from bosses switched to special item category
•	Bosses HP increased
•	Hero screen wildness update
•	Active serum effect duration is now displayed in the Hero screen
•	Decreased number of enemies in Flora Facility
•	Added Language option to Game Settings
•	Added possibility to drop serum from the inventory
•	Added autosave when destroying walls and vines to get rid of issue with walls and vines reappearing
•	Removed Duration from Wheel Menu and replaced it with Blight Protection

notes.title: Serum Patch #5 is now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/b92f362fde04aaafef044c317c19d98af053d564.png[/img]

Calling all Survivors,

We’ve been quite busy these past few weeks since launch and are pleased to announce that patch #5 is now live for Serum. This latest patch brings in fixes for localization on languages, freestanding absorbers for wilderness cleansing and an updated trap system, as well as music and sound effects in boss arenas and other fixes.

[h3]EA v0.1.4 | build 11591[/h3]

[list]
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Free-standing Absorbers placed on the map to allow cleansing from wildness
[*] New boss fight music
[*] New trap system - ghost red/green notifying the possibility of putting a trap in a right place
[*] Toadstool and Blind Frog are now highlighted red when using the Masking skill
[*] Bleeding serum effect on weapons now properly deals damage over time
[*] Quest page no longer displays future objectives (previously the page listed a whole quest chain instead of only the current part)
[*] Fixed Gate puzzles player snapping on interaction (player body is no longer visible when solving a gate puzzle)
[*] Free-standing absorbers - these absorbers heal and remove wildness only ; they do not remove or add the Timer,
[*] Locations: Forest Biome: Forest Refuge ; behind the Car graveyard ; Gas Station ; Train stop at the end of the railway line (left of the Fauna Facility, near the collapsed tunnel) - Swamp Biome: Swamp Refuge ; Entrance to Flora Facility; Nakata Boss (entrance to arena)
[/list]

Stay tuned for further updates and fixes.

Be sure to join the conversation on our Discord

If you’ve not yet begun your adventure of crafting, combat and survival, Serum is included in the Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: Serum Early Access Patch 4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/48692faad65dd513d36c108a78c82ac43e5399b1.png[/img]

[h3]Serum Patch #4 is now live[/h3]

Calling all Survivors,

Patch #4 is now live for Serum, this latest patch addressed a number of fixes and improvements including accelerated rotation to improve faster player response on controller, a fix for reappearing notes, recipes and blueprints, optimised non-streaming textures for improved performance. UI fixes, Wildness improvements and the implementation of Pause were also among other improvements added.

[h3]EA v0.1.4 | build 11436[/h3]
[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fix for reappearing notes, recipes and blueprints
[*] Got rid of items multiplication when "spamming" E button to collect them
[*] Fixed quest marker moving to the corners of the screen
[*] Fixed issue where Scolopendra was sometimes falling through the landscape
[*] Fixed issue where incorrect quest was set as active after loading the game
[/list]

[b]Changes and updates[/b]

[list]
[*] Implementation of pause function
[*] Implemented a new system for in-game fonts in dialogs for better scaling
[*] Optimized non-streaming textures for improved performance
[*] New storage screen based on finalized design
[*] Block mechanic changed - permanent block using stamina
[*] Implementing wildness-reducing effect on some plants
[*] Decreasing wildness values for early-stage Serums
[*] Tweaks for enemies: removed some spawners and disabled health regeneration
[*] Adjustments for the controller - accelerated rotation to improve faster player response, removed cursor snapping and added cursor slowdown when hovering over buttons
[/list]

[h3]Stay tuned for coming updates and fixes we’re addressing in the weeks ahead.[/h3]

Join the conversation on our [url=https://discord.gg/fvuWbPMb66]Discord[/url] and stay up to date with [b]Serum[/b] news and updates on our social channels.

notes.title: Serum Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/006664a23ca74b86f3879db240e5f40269c35bbb.png[/img]

[h3]Fellow Survivors,[/h3]

Today, we wanted to share the content and features still to come for [b]Serum[/b] since we know that timely updates, fixes, and implementing community feedback are important to you, the player.

By far, the biggest decision has been to give co-op more time in development and integrate this later than planned within the early access window. While this may be disappointing to many of you, we feel it’s very important we can deliver updates and game content that live up to players' expectations because sacrificing the quality of the game is something we very much want to avoid.

The Serum roadmap below highlights the continued work going into Serum in the weeks and months ahead, leading up to the Version 1.0 release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/d28f10a112e2560371656faf496a6e1ec66adcd1.png[/img]

[b]Quality of Life Fixes[/b]

First and foremost, our focus is to implement a range of quality-of-life improvements for players as one of our first tasks on Serum. This includes [b]bug fixes[/b] and [b]additional languages[/b] and translations, and we’ll continually look at player feedback to implement these so that the player experience in Serum is optimised.

As our early access journey gets underway next on our list will be [b]achievements[/b] as we know that rewarding player interactions and milestones is important. We’ll also be looking to implement a [b]UI revamp[/b] to ensure that it’s consistently intuitive for players as they brew, craft and upgrade in the game.

Further down the road, the roadmap also plans on introducing new combat options with [b]combat traps[/b] allowing players to expand their arsenal of weapons with passive capability to trap adversaries in the game world.

[b]New Biome[/b]

Canyon will be the third biome for players to explore in addition to ground zero (the node), the forest area and the swamp maps that are currently available. Canyon will introduce some new challenging adversaries and a new level boss creature to defeat as part of the game's narrative. This is a dry, arid location that will challenge the player with additional side quests to seek out survivors and reveal much more about the mutagen storyline.

[b]Co-op mode[/b]

Co-op mode for up to 4 players gives survivors an opportunity to tackle Serum’s infected denizens as a team with friends. Player resources will be shared, and by working together, players can create their own strategies to maximize their effectiveness in the Serum world.

Of course, early access will see our ongoing work to balance the game, add new features, tweak existing ones, and optimize the overall game. Community feedback is still important, so do talk to us via Discord. We are listening.

Join the conversation on our [url=https://discord.gg/fvuWbPMb66]Discord[/url] and stay up to date with [b]Serum[/b] news and updates on our social channels.

notes.title: The Serum Playtest is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/1d48f1241a3769d72d8817a8df17e77e9846221e.png[/img]

[h3]Fellow Survivors,[/h3]

Developer [b]Game Island[/b] and publisher [b]Toplitz Productions[/b] proudly announce the launch of the [b]Serum[/b] playtest. Now accessible on Steam.

The playtest will run from today through to [b]May 2nd, 7 pm CEST[/b], offering anyone brave enough a unique opportunity to provide us with valuable feedback on the game. This is an updated version of the game with two biomes to explore, noticeable tweaks to optimisation, an overhauled serum brewing UI, updated combat mechanics, animation, and a host of other enhancements as we prepare for its launch on [b]Steam Early Access[/b] in the coming weeks.

[previewyoutube=YgS6hhJgkPA;full][/previewyoutube]
Places are limited, and any players interested in joining the [b]Serum[/b] playtest can apply for access through the game's official Steam page here.

During your playtest, you may encounter various issues across different aspects of the game, including:

[list]
[*] Control-related problems – mouse button bind, controller inputs for text
[*] UI – resolution mismatches
[*] Save system – some glitches prevent proper game initialization
[*] Inventory management – problems with fixed storage slot count
[*] Gameplay inconsistencies – problems with facility and weapon upgrades
[*] Translation – some text strings may still be displayed in English despite the game running in a different language
[/list]
You may also encounter other miscellaneous bugs, such as lingering dialogue boxes, incorrect icon displays in crafting menus, and random crashes.

[h3]Take advantage of this exciting opportunity to help shape the future of the game. Your feedback is important to us.[/h3]

Join the conversation on our [url=https://discord.gg/fvuWbPMb66]Discord[/url] and stay up to date with [b]Serum[/b] news and updates on our social channels.

notes.title: Serum Exposed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/b4acce170ed0251ffdbe0fc9f0d0931a44a527a1.png[/img]

[h3]Fellow Survivors,[/h3]

We wanted to take you ‘behind the scenes’ into the development work going into [b]Serum[/b]. The [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] was useful for us in many ways, including how players interpreted the brewing UI and crafting system in the game. Additionally, though, we’re also working on some interesting new trap designs since we’re enhancing how that system will work in the game, among other things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/b0698f50efca3a8e23da4d91827a5a6a54a74989.png[/img]

Combat mechanics and creature enemy animation, including how some enemies move and react when they engage in combat, are also undergoing some further work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/11f851922daa5b426f5d4f5ecc251b6498d97875.png[/img]

Using [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b] means we’ve been able to really push the graphical capabilities and create some realistic visuals to help immerse players into the game's narrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/a5ff8d2bfb7c9bc24f0beebf08878a9acc8c80ef.png[/img]

[b]DLSS[/b] support is also being integrated into the game, and optimisation is another priority that we’re currently working on.

There is still lots to do, but thank you all for the constructive feedback. If you contacted us after playing the demo, we really appreciate it.

Join the conversation on our [url=https://discord.gg/fvuWbPMb66]Discord[/url] and stay up to date with [b]Serum[/b] news and updates on our social channels.
